programme.title: Mafia Raaj

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Main Hoon Chaalbaaz
programme.desc: Gudumba Shankar falls in love with Gowri and finds out that she is being forced to marry Kumar Swamy, a gangster. Shankar must find a way to stop him and save Gowri.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.desc: Gary Anderson tells the story of his PDC World Darts Championship triumphs in 2015 and 2016, as the Scotsman become only the third player to win back-to-back titles. Ep 6.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Bolton v M'boro 2003
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Bolton Wanderers fight for their top-flight survival against Middlesbrough on the final day of the 2002-03 season.

programme.title: PL Greatest Liverpool/Arsenal 2004
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Liverpool take on Arsenal back in 2004 at Anfield in a match that saw some late, late drama.

programme.title: PL Greatest Games:Leics/Everton'16
programme.desc: Relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Leicester City celebrate their iconic Premier League title triumph in style as they host Everton at the King Power Stadium in May 2016.

programme.title: PL Greatest:N Forest/Liverpool '92
programme.desc: Relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Nottingham Forest met Liverpool on the opening weekend of the inaugural Premier League season in 1992, in Sky Sports' first Premier League game.

programme.title: Australian F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: A McLaren one-two forms the front row for the Australian Grand Prix, as Lando Norris leads from Oscar Piastri. Max Verstappen starts third, while Lewis Hamilton begins from P8. (16.03)

programme.title: Chinese F1 GP Highlights
programme.desc: It's a first Grand Prix pole for Oscar Piastri as George Russell splits the McLarens with Lando Norris starting third. Sprint winner Lewis Hamilton comes from fifth on the grid. (23.03)

programme.title: EFL 16/17:Sheff Utd v Bristol City
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL. Here, Sheffield United host Bristol City at Bramall Lane in 2017 in a game with a late dramatic twist.

programme.title: EFL 16/17: Reading v Cardiff
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL. Here, Reading host Cardiff City at the Madejski Stadium in 2017 in a game with a thrilling conclusion.

programme.title: EFL 17/18: Bristol City v Man Utd
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL Cup. Here, Bristol City host Premier League Man Utd at Ashton Gate in the 2017-18 competition's quarter-finals.

programme.title: EFL 17/18: Leeds v Bristol City
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL. Here, Leeds United host Bristol City at Elland Road in the Sky Bet Championship in a match that saw a dramatic comeback.

programme.title: ATP/WTA Tour Classic Matches
programme.desc: In a rematch of the 2023 Madrid Open final, world number one Iga Swiatek and defending champion Aryna Sabalenka meet again to determine this year's women's singles champion.

programme.title: ATP/WTA Tour Classic Matches
programme.desc: Andre Agassi and Pete Sampras met in the 2001 Indian Wells final - one of 34 career meetings. Agassi eyed a second consecutive win over Sampras in their first meeting in over a year.

programme.title: EFL 17/18: Arsenal v Man City
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL Cup. Here, Arsenal and Man City go head-to-head in the final of the 2017-18 competition at Wembley.

programme.title: EFL 17/18: Aston Villa v Wolves
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL. Here, Aston Villa host Wolves at Villa Park in a memorable Midlands derby in the 2017-18 campaign.

programme.title: EFL 17/18: Fulham v QPR
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic match from the EFL. Here, promotion-chasing Fulham host QPR at Craven Cottage in a west London derby that saw a memorable comeback.

programme.title: Ted DHL Logistics
programme.desc: Sky F1's Ted Kravitz looks at how DHL - the international shipping company - play a key role in Formula 1 logistics.

programme.title: Live F1 Testing: Bahrain 2026
programme.desc: The second Formula 1 pre-season test continues with day two's morning session. Mercedes' George Russell ended the first day of running on top, followed by Oscar Piastri and Charles Leclerc.

programme.title: Carlos Sainz & The Lie Detector
programme.desc: Williams' Carlos Sainz is the latest Formula 1 driver to brave the Lie Detector.

programme.title: Las Vegas F1 GP 2025
programme.desc: Bitesize highlights from the 2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix. Championship leader Lando Norris starts from P1 with Max Verstappen behind. Oscar Piastri lines up in fifth place. (23.11)

programme.title: F1 Explained: Pit Lane Battle
programme.desc: In the next instalment of the F1 Explained series, Sky F1's Bernie Collins explains pit-lane battles.

programme.title: F1 Explained: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: In the next instalment of the F1 Explained series, Karun Chandhok looks at Formula 1's guidelines for driving standards.

programme.title: F1 Explained: DRS
programme.desc: In the next instalment of the F1 Explained series, Sky F1's Martin Brundle unpacks the Drag Reduction System - commonly referred to as DRS.

programme.title: Live F1 Testing: Bahrain 2026
programme.desc: Formula 1 pre-season testing continues at Bahrain International Circuit.

programme.title: The Story of the 2025 Season
programme.desc: This is the story of the 2025 F1 world championship - an unforgettable one for those stood tall at the end, full of twists and turns in the race the drivers' and constructors' titles.

programme.title: Oscar Piastri's Career
programme.desc: A look at the fledgling career of the young Aussie driver Oscar Piastri, who at the age of 24 has already achieved so much in Formula 1.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Man Utd/Liverpool '09
programme.desc: A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, Manchester United host rivals Liverpool at Old Trafford back in 2009 in a match that saw five goals.

programme.title: PL Greatest:Bradford/Liverpool '00
programme.desc: A chance to relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Bradford City take on Liverpool at Valley Parade back in 2000 in one of the Bantams' great Premier League matches.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Leeds/Liverpool 2000
programme.desc: A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, Leeds take on Liverpool at Elland Road in a captivating seven-goal thriller back in 2000 that saw Mark Viduka score four times.

programme.title: PL Greatest: Man City v QPR '12
programme.desc: A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, arguably the Premier League's most memorable moment, as Man City take on QPR on the final day of the 2011-12 season...Aguerroooooo!

programme.title: PGA Tour Golf Highlights
programme.desc: The final day of the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, a PGA Tour event staged in California. Rory McIlroy finished two clear of Shane Lowry to claim victory a year ago. (15.02)

programme.title: Live WCC: Hull KR v Brisbane
programme.desc: In a clash of champions, Hull's MKM Stadium sees the Betfred Super League-winning Robins take on NRL Premiers Brisbane Broncos in the 2026 Betfred World Club Challenge.

programme.title: PGA Tour Champions Highlights
programme.desc: Tournament highlights from the Chubb Classic - a PGA Tour Champions event held at Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida. The 1997 Open winner Justin Leonard won this event last year.

programme.title: Rob Cross: A Year To Remember 2018
programme.desc: At the first time of asking, Rob Cross shocked the world on his PDC World Darts Championship debut by defeating the retiring Phil Taylor in the final at Alexandra Palace in 2018. Ep 7.

programme.title: Peter Wright: Double Champ 20 & 22
programme.desc: A two-time winner of the coveted Sid Waddell Trophy, Peter 'Snakebite' Wright recounts the highs and lows of PDC World Darts Championship glory. Ep 8.

programme.desc: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.

programme.title: Anurodh

programme.title: Dhongee
